card.name: Linking words inside multiword phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words or modifiers such as 'of', 'on', 'or', 'similar', 'chronic' and '-term' that sit in the middle of a stock phrase and expect a specific noun next, in technical or label text.

modes.label: Linking words in set phrases
modes.description: A preposition or conjunction inside a fixed phrase such as 'built on top of' or 'in terms of'.
modes.example: Solr is a Java based Apache open source search server built on top<< of>> Lucene.
